thread:
Sam (CEO): Quick post-all-hands thread: one-line why we won, one-line why we lost, and one concrete 30d ask. Keep it tight.

Marco (VP Product): Win: predictable latency + simple model pinning. Loss: friction moving pilots to Private. 30d ask: draft private quickstart checklist.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: hands-on onboarding closes deals. Loss: pilot billing surprises. 30d ask: publish pilot invoice sample + FAQ.

Ethan (Sales): Win: demo latency & fallback stories. Loss: RFPs asking for air-gap docs and SOC excerpts. 30d ask: assemble RFP "security packet".

Priya (Eng): Win: runtime perf on short chat flows. Loss: quantized long-seq regressions. 30d ask: spec for long-seq perf smoke test.

Nina (Solutions): Customers want a single audit bundle we can attach to RFPs. 30d ask: I'll draft audit bundle skeleton and invite CS/Legal.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks owners by EOD tomorrow and a KPI for each (pilot TAT, RFP conversion rate, long-seq p95).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-9002: "Private quickstart + RFP security packet" assigned to Marco + Nina, due 30d.

Leah (Customer Success): @Ethan DM me the three RFPs that requested air-gap docs so we can attach examples.

Ethan (Sales): Will DM now. Also drafting a one-page AE rebuttal card for billing and air-gap.

Priya (Eng): Tagging eng-runtime & eng-infra for the smoke test spike. Will post a short spec in eng-runtime.

Sam (CEO): Thanks — focus on reducing pilot friction and RFP friction. Escalate blockers to me.

Marco (VP Product): I'll post owners + ticket links tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
